description: Forward compatibility for the frozen firmware: budgets both sides hold every device body to, and what a v3 court box and a v3 door gate adopt from bodies a later server might send.

budgets.note: hb:3 body; widest http/ vector v3-heartbeat-response-widest
widest realistic reply ~240 B (court, booking_id, granted, play_remaining, member_display 16, greeting 16, balance)
the reply is {accepted_through, recorded} forever; new information goes in the heartbeat
with telemetry; widest http/ vector v3-heartbeat-request-widest
the 2.x contract; FC-3 is recorded, not reopened
v3 gate body; widest is membercode/gate.json codes-full plus every v3 object at its bound
same reply as the court box
FC-6: over 127 B reads as status 0 and teaches the breaker

cases.note: the base body itself: everything adopted, nothing drifted
an unknown key before everything is ignored
FC-7: a future object BEFORE config that carries button_map, roster and courts of its own; the board reads known keys only where they live, so none of them is adopted from it
a nested object inside config that carries button_map and lcd_layout: config is read one level deep only
unknown config keys of every JSON kind are ignored
FC-1: a fifth field on every roster element is ignored, never a refusal
FC-1: a sixth field on every courts element is ignored
an unknown kind letter is display-only: lit reads as a booking, dark as dark
FC-1: a key element may grow a '|' suffix; the first 21 characters are the key
a third field on a day slot is ignored
a roster in a grammar this board does not know is never committed as empty: the previous roster stays and the drift is reported
unreadable elements are skipped, the rest committed, the drift reported
an explicit [] is 'no bookings' and is committed
a key ring in an unknown grammar keeps the previous ring
an empty snapshot changes nothing (the reconcile is ON-only)
an unreadable court list keeps the previous map whole (positions are relays)
FC-11: a fraction, an exponent, a quoted number and a negative read as absent (previous value kept, drift reported); never truncated
a quoted bool reads as absent
hardware facts other than the defaults, adopted
an unknown relay level, LCD address or baud keeps the current value: a remote guess never flips the relay drive
an unknown layout is compact
a button map with a token this board does not know keeps the previous map whole
a valid remap is adopted
duplicate keys resolve first-wins on the board; the server never emits one
a UTF-8 BOM and leading whitespace are skipped; the server never sends either
whitespace between tokens is tolerated; the server sends compact
an unknown value nested eight deep is skipped
past 32 levels the scanner refuses the body whole: nothing adopted
not one object: nothing adopted
an HTML 200 (a captive portal, a proxy page): nothing adopted
a body cut mid-way: nothing adopted
a body of exactly 4096 bytes, the server's maximum: adopted
a body of 5120 bytes cannot be held whole: nothing adopted
FC-4: every 2xx is a success
a 2xx with no body adopts nothing and is not a failure of the link
a 500 adopts nothing
a 401 adopts nothing and retries once with the previous key
the lifeline: ota, key_next and net are adopted from a complete body even when its roster, courts and config are in a grammar this board does not know
a lifeline-only body (the server's answer when everything would not fit): the lifeline is adopted and everything absent keeps its value
a future field inside ota, key_next or net is ignored
a v3 box on a pre-v3 server: relays elements with a fourth field are read
the base body itself
FC-12: a nested object inside `gate` that carries unlock_seconds first: only the gate object's own scalars are settings
unknown gate settings are ignored
FC-8: device_fault_* inside the gate object are read
a fifth roster field is ignored
an unknown roster grammar keeps the previous roster
DG-9: an answer whose kind is not gate adopts no roster, keys or settings
a fraction and a quoted number read as absent
the lifeline survives a roster and gate object it cannot read
every 2xx is a success
nothing adopted
a body of exactly 6144 bytes, the server's maximum: adopted
8192 bytes cannot be held whole

scan.note: unknown fields of every kind are ignored
FC-4: a 201 is a success
a pre-v3 server: play_remaining falls back to granted
an unreadable 200 is undecided: the roster decides
FC-11: activated as a string is unreadable: undecided
512 bytes cannot be held: undecided
FC-4: a 201 grant lights the court (2.3.0 read it as SEE THE DESK and charged)
a 202 with future fields
a 2xx with no body is undecided: BUSY, nonce kept
FC-11: granted_minutes as a string is undecided, never the requested minutes
a readable 409 is a decided refusal
an unreadable 409 is still a decided refusal
429 is undecided
5xx is undecided
FC-4
a field-less 200 is undecided (unchanged)
accepted_through is read whatever else the reply grows
every 2xx
FC-5: 192 bytes cannot be held: nothing released, retried with backoff
unknown fields ignored
every 2xx
unreadable: decided offline
256 bytes cannot be held: decided offline
the same events reply on the gate
